key_insights: CSS Profile is used by roughly 300 mostly private/selective colleges for institutional (non-federal) aid and factors in more assets than FAFSA, including home equity, savings, and investments.
Because it captures more family assets, CSS Profile can raise a family's computed contribution and reduce eligibility for a college's own grant funds, especially for families with home equity.
CSS Profile can also feed into merit scholarship decisions at some schools even when the award is nominally grade- or talent-based.
Opens earlier than FAFSA, so families applying early decision/action should prepare it early; fee waivers exist for eligible students.
Recommends completing both FAFSA and CSS Profile where required and reviewing entries carefully since mistakes can affect aid.
specific_numbers_or_facts: Video states about 300 colleges/scholarship programs use the CSS Profile.
